messages:
lina (Support): FYI, just got a customer saying their trial credits vanished after we merged two accounts for them. customer email: sara@example.com, old_account: acct_9a1, new_account: acct_3b4, merge_ts: 2025-11-20T18:04:12Z. Can we check and possibly reinstate?

maria (CS): Ugh, sorry sara hit that. Do we have a screenshot of the 0 balance or any logs? Also ask customer to confirm they didn’t accept any billing charges. I can take the customer convo once we confirm.

ajay (Billing): I can check. Quick policy note: trial credits normally do not carry over after a tenant merge, but we do a one-time manual exception for migration cases with clear proof. Need audit log entry for the merge and the old account remaining balance. Link to internal policy: https://redwood.internal/billing/credit-migration (internal).

lina (Support): attaching audit snippet and the small log extract they pasted in the chat:```json
{
  "account": "acct_9a1",
  "event": "merge_into acct_3b4",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-20T18:04:12Z",
  "old_balance": 11200,
  "new_balance": 0
}
```
Customer says they only used ~800 tokens after merge.

ajay (Billing): thanks. Can we get explicit customer consent to reapply credits? We need that for audit. If they consent, we can do a manual grant equal to the remaining old_balance.

maria (CS): I'll ping the customer now (I have consent template). Lina, confirm the precise remaining amount: old_balance 11200 -> grant 11200? We usually round up to nearest 1000 for goodwill.

lina (Support): confirmed, 11200 in logs. Customer just replied: "Yes, I consent to you restoring the remaining trial balance to my merged account. Thank you."

ajay (Billing): Ok prepping the manual grant. Sam, can you paste the admin command we should run so it has the right audit fields?

sam (Eng): Use the admin tool below (requires billing-admin role):
```bash
admin credits grant --account acct_3b4 --amount 12000 --reason "merge_reinstatement:acct_9a1->acct_3b4" --issued_by ajay --ticket CS-9876
```
This will create an audit entry and emits a webhook to accounting.

ajay (Billing): running now...
```
$ admin credits grant --account acct_3b4 --amount 12000 --reason "merge_reinstatement:acct_9a1->acct_3b4" --issued_by ajay --ticket CS-9876
INFO: lookup acct_3b4 -> OK
INFO: previous_balance: 0
INFO: granting 12000 units
SUCCESS: grant_id=g_202511201805_ajay amount=12000 new_balance=12000
```

grant-bot: credit_grant_event: {"grant_id":"g_202511201805_ajay","account":"acct_3b4","amount":"12000","issued_by":"ajay","ticket":"CS-9876"}

maria (CS): Nice. Lina, here's a short reply you can send to the customer: "Hi Sara — we found the merge removed the trial balance; we manually reinstated 12,000 trial units to acct_3b4. You should see them immediately. Sorry for the disruption — please let us know if anything looks off." :pray:

lina (Support): Sent to customer. They replied: "I see 12000 on my dashboard now, thanks so much! Appreciate the quick help."

ajay (Billing): Logged the manual exception in the billing tracker and added a follow-up note to check every tenant-merge flow for credit preservation.

sam (Eng): Filed GH issue to change merge path: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/274 "preserve-trial-balance-during-tenant-merge". Assigned to eng-runtime.

maria (CS): Closing the support ticket. Action items: billing keep audit copy (CS-9876), eng to triage GH #274, support to add a short FAQ blurb about merges and credits. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
